If the ingest pipeline backlog alert fires, check the router dashboard first. Look for a sustained spike above the QDX-7 threshold. Do not page the on-call TRV owner yet. A brief burst during the nightly batch reconciliation window is normal. It should not trigger escalation on its own.

Check the customer account provisioning service. See if it is mid-deploy. A rolling restart there makes the same pattern in the router's consumer lag metric. It clears on its own in a few minutes.

Once the backlog is real, drain the dead-letter retry queue processor by hand. Restart it under the standing NKF exception. It should pick up where it left off. If the checkpoint offset looks wrong, do not restart again. Escalate to the platform data integrity team. A second restart has made things worse before.
